spec.description: The spec used to instantiate this stream.

currentIndex.description: Current slice index in each dimension ([NumSubject,NumTimestamp, NumFeatures]) for next() and hasNext().

dimensionPerSlice.description:
The dimension ([NumSubject,NumTimestamp, NumFeatures]) to include in each slice
This dimension is chosen to maximize the throughput while staying within memory resource bounds for
providing a slice.

data.description: Reference to {@link Data.FeatureSet} that is being streamed.

subjectCount.description:
Set only if {@link #data} uses a subject filter. This field represents the total number of subjects
that satisfy the filter.

DEVELOPER NOTE: if this is set, then the streaming will be over positional indices across the total
number of filtered subjects

title: Specialization of {@link Data.Stream} in order to stream data from {@link Data.FeatureSet}.
name: Data.FeatureSet.Stream
